statement.text:
Does there exist a massive set of independent elements in a free group F2 on
free generators a, b, that is, a set E of irreducible words on the alphabet a, b, a−1 , b−1
such that
    1) no element w ∈ E belongs to the normal closure  p of E \ {w}, and
    2) the massiveness condition is satisfied: lim n |En | = 3, where En is the set of
                                                 n→∞
all words of length n in E?                                             R. I. Grigorchuk
